posts.text:
Last night @OversightDems received an alarming whistleblower report from a USPS federal official that President Trump's attack on vote-by-mail is much more serious than previously known.

Trump is creating a new tracking system at the US Postal Service that is untested, dangerous, and threatens to totally disrupt ballot delivery for millions of American citizens. 

This is an unconstitutional and dangerous power grab and must be permanently and immediately blocked. We are fighting in the courts
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump's vote-by-mail tracking system as dangerous threat to voting
